sources.note: University of Manitoba Financial Aid and Awards page for the International Excellence Entrance Scholarship — the awarding body's own page, read in full.

awarding_body.detail: The page is on umanitoba.ca, the University of Manitoba's official domain, and names the University of Manitoba as the awarding body for the scholarship.
awarding_body.quote: One University of Manitoba International Excellence Entrance Scholarship valued at $25,000 will be offered to students who:

deadline.detail: The page states the 2027/28 application cycle is now open and that the complete application and all required documentation must be received by December 1. Checked on 12 October 2026, the December 1 deadline for the open 2027/28 cycle falls on 1 December 2026, matching the record's deadline_date of 2026-12-01. This is a currently-open cycle with a future deadline.
deadline.quote: The application for the 2027/28 International Excellence Entrance Scholarship is now open. Complete application and all required documentation must be received by December 1.

eligibility.detail: All distinct eligibility claims confirmed: international high school graduates; full-time (minimum 80% course load) enrolment in the first year of study in University 1 or any faculty, college or school with a direct entry option; the $25,000 award requires a minimum 90% admission average across five listed senior level high school courses plus demonstrated strong leadership and sustained, meaningful community involvement; the two $10,000 awards require the minimum admission requirements for the programme plus demonstrated strong leadership. Both tiers also require a completed UM application for admission by December 1st including payment of the application fee, and one letter of recommendation from a teacher or principal.
eligibility.quote: are enrolled full-time (minimum 80% course load) in the first year of study in University 1 or any faculty, college or school at the University of Manitoba with a direct entry option.

funding.detail: The page gives fixed award values of one $25,000 award and two $10,000 awards, matching the record's 'Entrance scholarship, partial funding'. These are fixed-value entrance awards, not a full-cost (fully funded) award — tuition, fees and living costs are not covered in full.
funding.quote: Each year, one award valued at $25,000 and two awards valued at $10,000 will be given out to three exceptional international high school graduates who demonstrate outstanding leadership potential and academic giftedness.

degree_levels.detail: The scholarship is an undergraduate entrance award for the first year of study in University 1 or direct entry into a faculty, college or school, consistent with the record's Bachelor's level.
degree_levels.quote: Two University of Manitoba International Excellence Entrance Scholarships valued at $10,000 each will be offered to international undergraduate students who:

recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Re-checked live on 2026-10-12 against the official umanitoba.ca page; 2027/28 cycle confirmed open with December 1 deadline (falls 2026-12-01). Page states deadline as 'December 1' without a year; year inferred from the stated 2027/28 cycle. Full application details (reference letter from teacher/principal, UM admission application by December 1st with fee) are on the official page; the 'Learn how to apply' link leads to the apply.umanitoba.ca portal.
